final_claim:
In the Boolean zero-divisor graph of \((\mathbb F_2)^{2m}\), \(m\ge3\), deleting two landmarks \(X,Y\) from the full middle layer \(W_m\) preserves resolution exactly when \(Y
e X^c\); equivalently complementary middle pairs are the unique graph-vertex pairs with exactly two middle-layer distinguishers, and after one deletion the complementary landmark is uniquely essential.
limitations: Only two deletions from the full middle layer are classified; this is not a complete fault-tolerant metric-dimension computation.
An equivalent central-layer robustness theorem could exist under fault-tolerant resolving-set terminology outside the indexed literature, but no such source was found.
